claim_text: Our emissions intensity has increased by approximately 3% from 0.53 tonnes of CO2e per ounce of gold in FY24 to 0.56 in FY25.
context_text:
[Table] GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS INTENSITY FY2025 FY2024 FY2023
Emissions per Gold Produced (kg CO2-e/oz) 561.4 531.1 514.1.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The table supports that emissions intensity increased, but the reported values imply an increase larger than approximately 3%, so the quantitative phrasing is not fully matched.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that emissions intensity increased by about 3%, from 0.53 tCO2e/oz in FY24 to 0.56 tCO2e/oz in FY25. The evidence table reports “Emissions per Gold Produced (kg CO2-e/oz)” of 531.1 in FY2024 and 561.4 in FY2025, which correspond to 0.5311 and 0.5614 tonnes CO2e/oz, matching the claimed 0.53 and 0.56 when rounded. The increase is 561.4−531.1=30.3 kg CO2e/oz, which is 30.3/531.1≈5.7%, so the direction and endpoints are supported but the stated “approximately 3%” is not numerically aligned with the provided values.
